Build four integrated tabs from the Assumptions sheet covering FY2022A-FY2030P: Enterprise P&L, Working Capital, Debt Schedule, and an FY2024A-to-FY2025B EBITDA Bridge. Use the existing model structure, units, and formatting conventions.

Build the Enterprise P&L through Net Income. Link operating assumptions to the Assumptions sheet and debt interest to the Debt Schedule. Include Depreciation & Amortization, Operating Income (EBIT), QoE Adjustments, Adjusted EBITDA, Interest Expense, Other Income/(Expense), Tax Expense, Net Income, and the associated margins. Use non-operating other income of 4.8, 4.8, 4.7, 4.4, 3.9, 4.2, 4.3, 4.5, and 4.7 for FY2022A-FY2030P, respectively. Calculate tax on positive pre-tax income using the consolidated effective tax rate on the Assumptions sheet.

Build the Working Capital schedule on a 365-day basis using:

- DSO: 42.7 days in FY2022A; 42.5 days in FY2023A and FY2024A; and 42.0 days from FY2025B onward.
- DIH: 60.0 days in FY2022A; 52.0 days in FY2023A; 49.0 days in FY2024A; and 48.0 days from FY2025B onward.
- DPO: 105.0 days in FY2022A; 94.0 days in FY2023A; 110.0 days in FY2024A; and 105.0 days from FY2025B onward.
- Prepaids: 0.0% of operating expenses.
- Accrued liabilities: 10.0% of operating expenses.
- Deferred revenue: 0.0% of revenue.

Build the Debt Schedule with two tranches and calculate interest using average beginning and ending balances:

- Term loan: opening balance of 3.5 in FY2022A, with mandatory repayments of 0.5 per year beginning in FY2022A and continuing until fully repaid. Apply a 0.0% interest rate in FY2022A and FY2023A and a 10.0% rate from FY2024A onward while a balance remains outstanding.
- Line of credit: opening balance of 1.5 in FY2022A, with repayments of 0.5 in FY2023A, 0.5 in FY2024A, and 0.3 in FY2025B. Assume no subsequent draws or repayments, leaving the remaining 0.2 balance outstanding through FY2030P. Apply a 10.0% interest rate throughout FY2022A-FY2030P.

Build the FY2024A-to-FY2025B EBITDA Bridge as a formula-driven walk from FY2024A EBITDA to FY2025B EBITDA. Show separate variance steps for:

- Segment Alpha revenue
- Segment Beta revenue
- Segment Gamma revenue
- All remaining revenue lines combined as "Other Revenue Lines"
- COGS
- Customer Acquisition
- Postal Charges
- Staff Costs
- SG&A
- Other OpEx

Include columns for component, period-over-period value change, running cumulative EBITDA, and component type. Also include a formula-driven waterfall-chart helper block with Base, Increase, Decrease, and Total columns ready to plot, and a short summary showing starting EBITDA, total change, and ending EBITDA

Link all schedules to the Assumptions sheet and to one another. Keep the model's colour convention for typed inputs versus formulas and cross-sheet links, and make sure the schedules tie out before you send it back.
